IS 14580 : Part 2 : 2006 Use of Network Analysis for Project Management Part 2 Use of Graphic TechniquesMSD 4Reaffirmed 20151 ScopeThis standard (Part 2) deals with the various graphictechniques used in project management in its variousaspects and during its various phases of execution.
